{{Top|leg}}
'''Magma missiles''' were Yuuzhan Vong guided missiles, widely used by their [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]].

==Description==
A magma missile was a solid projectile with a rocky outward appearance, presumably formed from solidified [[Magma/Legends|magma]]. They were fired from missile launchers known as [[rock spitter]]s.<ref name="SbS">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref> Like the [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] used by warships of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]], they were capable of looping flightpaths to attack targets outside of their launcher's direct field of fire.<ref name="DW">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref>

Magma missiles were thus very different in appearance and performance from the molten slugs fired by [[Plasma cannon/Legends|plasma cannons]], which were unguided, line-of-sight artillery projectiles, the Yuuzhan Vong equivalent of [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] bolts. Nonetheless, rock spitters were regularly combined with plasma cannons in mixed weapons batteries aboard Yuuzhan Vong warships.<ref name="SbS" /><ref name="DW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The existence of a separate Yuuzhan Vong guided missile system is established in ''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]'' and ''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]'', but the distinction between the plasma cannon and the magma missile has been blurred in other sources. As a result, it is not clear whether the rock spitter should be considered along with the plasma cannon as a variety of [[Yaret-Kor]].
